title: Emotional optimization by newsroom AI needs behavioural evaluation - Nature Machine Intelligence
gist: A Nature Machine Intelligence comment argues that newsroom AI performing 'emotional packaging' changes how stories feel and shapes whether people approach, trust and share them, so AI and behavioural researchers should jointly test whether it helps accurate information reach readers or deepens division.

insights.claim: When newsroom AI engages in emotional packaging, it changes how a story feels, shaping whether people approach, trust and share it.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: Editorial AI affects engagement and trust, relevant to media publishers and platforms optimizing distribution.
insights.quote: it changes how a story feels, shaping whether people approach, trust and share it

insights.claim: AI researchers and behavioural scientists should work together as these systems are designed and deployed to test whether emotional packaging helps accurate information reach readers and whether it deepens division.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: Points to a need for evaluation standards and potential regulatory scrutiny of emotion-optimizing news AI.
insights.quote: AI and behavioural researchers should work together
